summary: State of California Department of Managed Health Care (DMHC) formal intake response and Requested Information Sheet dated August 7, 2026 regarding Case #23. The Help Center requires completion of the IMR application, a signed medical release, and the Authorized Assistant form within a strict seven-day statutory window (no later than August 14, 2026) to proceed.

DEPARTMENT OF MANAGED HEALTH CARE
980 9th Street, Suite 500
Sacramento, CA 95814
Toll-Free: 1-888-466-2219 | Fax: 916-255-5241
www.DMHC.ca.gov

August 7, 2026

NICOLAS HERNANDEZ
[Address Redacted]

Patient: Nicolas Hernandez
DMHC#: 23
Health Plan: Local Initiative Health Authority for L.A. County (L.A. Care Health Plan)

Dear Nicolas Hernandez:

Thank you for sending your Independent Medical Review (IMR)/Complaint Form to the Department of Managed Health Care (Department).

You are receiving this letter because additional information is required to process your request. Please refer to the "Requested Information Sheet" on Page 3 of this letter for the specific information needed.

Please submit the requested information along with the Requested Information Sheet (Page 3 of this letter) to the Department no later than (08/14/2026). Please note you must include the Requested Information Sheet (Page 3) to ensure the information you submit is attached to your case.

The quickest way to return this information to the Department is by sending it via email to helpline@dmhc.ca.gov or by fax to 916-255-5241.

Sincerely,
Initial Review Section
Help Center
Department of Managed Health Care

---
PAGE 3: REQUESTED INFORMATION SHEET

[X] Please complete all sections of the enclosed IMR/Complaint Form.
[X] Please complete and sign the Medical Release section on the enclosed IMR/Complaint Form.
[X] Please complete the highlighted section(s) of the enclosed Authorized Assistant Form. If we do not receive a completed Authorized Assistant form, we can still process your IMR/Complaint. However, we will only be able to share information about the IMR/Complaint with you.
